```bash
sqlite3 -readonly -header "$S" "$E SELECT id, book||' '||chapter||':'||verse AS ref, position, field, outcome, lane3, sv AS source_value, cv AS corrected_value, cell AS src_cell FROM o ORDER BY book, chapter, verse, position, field"
echo "=== (2) src's rows in the 18 lane-3 verses (ref|position|english|english_head|greek_pos|bracket_id|strongs_base|op = a lane-3 op cell) ==="
sqlite3 -readonly -header "$S" "WITH $L3, $L3V SELECT v.book||' '||v.chapter||':'||v.verse AS ref, w.position, w.english, w.english_head, w.greek_pos, w.bracket_id, w.strongs_base, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM l3 WHERE l3.book = v.book AND l3.chapter = v.chapter AND l3.verse = v.verse AND l3.position = w.position) THEN 'op' ELSE '' END AS op FROM words w JOIN verses v ON v.id = w.verse_id JOIN l3v ON l3v.book = v.book AND l3v.chapter = v.chapter AND l3v.verse = v.verse ORDER BY v.book, v.chapter, v.verse, w.position"
echo "-- verses found / op cells found (expect 18 / 47):"
sqlite3 -readonly "$S" "WITH $L3, $L3V SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM l3v JOIN verses v ON v.book = l3v.book AND v.chapter = l3v.chapter AND v.verse = l3v.verse), (SELECT count(*) FROM l3 JOIN verses v ON v.book = l3.book AND v.chapter = l3.chapter AND v.verse = l3.verse JOIN words w ON w.verse_id = v.id AND w.position = l3.position)"
echo "=== (3) '--' left on src (expect 0 and 0: fix_emdash ran on src's 10/25 chain and nothing later wrote verses.text) ==="
sqlite3 -readonly "$S" "SELECT 'verses.text', count(*) FROM verses WHERE text LIKE '%--%' UNION ALL SELECT 'words.english', count(*) FROM words WHERE english LIKE '%--%'"
echo "-- first 20 hits of each (expect none below this line):"
sqlite3 -readonly "$S" "SELECT 'verses', book||' '||chapter||':'||verse, text FROM verses WHERE text LIKE '%--%' LIMIT 20"
sqlite3 -readonly "$S" "SELECT 'words', v.book||' '||v.chapter||':'||v.verse, w.position, w.english FROM words w JOIN verses v ON v.id = w.verse_id WHERE w.english LIKE '%--%' LIMIT 20"
echo "=== (4) the 11 retired greek_pos rows with src's cell (expect 11 rows; src_cell = corrected_value on each, DESIGN 9.161 (4) (a)) ==="
sqlite3 -readonly -header "$S" "SELECT c.id, c.book||' '||c.chapter||':'||c.verse AS ref, c.position, c.source_value, c.corrected_value, w.greek_pos AS src_cell, CASE WHEN w.greek_pos IS NOT NULL AND CAST(w.greek_pos AS TEXT) = c.corrected_value THEN 'corrected' WHEN w.greek_pos IS NOT NULL AND CAST(w.greek_pos AS TEXT) = c.source_value THEN 'SOURCE' ELSE 'NEITHER' END AS src_holds FROM abp_corrections c LEFT JOIN verses v ON v.book = c.book AND v.chapter = c.chapter AND v.verse = c.verse LEFT JOIN words w ON w.verse_id = v.id AND w.position = c.position WHERE c.status = 'retired' AND c.field = 'greek_pos' ORDER BY c.id"
echo "=== (5) Joh 14:26 on src (expect @3 greek_pos and bracket_id blank, DESIGN 9.153 (1) write 4) ==="
sqlite3 -readonly -header "$S" "SELECT w.position, w.english, w.english_head, w.greek_pos, w.bracket_id FROM words w JOIN verses v ON v.id = w.verse_id WHERE v.book = 'Joh' AND v.chapter = 14 AND v.verse = 26 ORDER BY w.position"
# --- after ---
st1=$(stat -c '%s %Y %n' "$S" "$B")
echo "src and built: size and time before = after: $([ "$st1" = "$st0" ] && echo yes || echo NO)"
[ "$st1" = "$st0" ] || { echo "SRCREAD RESULT: STOP - a copy changed during a read-only run - report this"; exit 1; }
echo "SRCREAD RESULT: READ DONE - no gate; every expect above is a read-out for the ruling chat; run folder $D left empty"; exit 0
) 2>&1 | tee "$L"; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; fi
```

```bash
du -sk ~ 2>/dev/null
```

```bash

LIVE=~/bible-db/bible.db
# declared figures, each from a PA log line:

XWC=7d789d5c2c22598f238a2ddcb8e100c435402588437db956fef13df125cac522   # delta/words_cells.tsv: same log, the delta's file list

for f in "$T" "$D/delta/words_cells.tsv" "$R/step4_c_control_20261117.log" "$S" "$B" "$P" "$LIVE"; do

  [ -L "$f" ] && { echo "RMTC RESULT: STOP - a link, not a file: $f; nothing removed"; exit 1; }
done
for f in "$S" "$B" "$P" "$LIVE"; do [ "$T" -ef "$f" ] && { echo "RMTC RESULT: STOP - T_c.db is the same file as $f; nothing removed"; exit 1; }; done
[ -w "$T" ] && [ -w "$D" ] || { echo "RMTC RESULT: STOP - T_c.db or its folder is not writable (rm would ask on the terminal); nothing removed"; exit 1; }
for x in -journal -wal -shm; do [ -e "$T$x" ] && { echo "RMTC RESULT: STOP - a $x file beside T_c.db (left as is for the ruling chat); nothing removed"; exit 1; }; done
r=$(sed -n '/^CCTL RESULT: /p' "$R/step4_c_control_20261117.log"); echo "CCTL log result line: $r"
[ "$r" = "$XRES" ] || { echo "RMTC RESULT: STOP - the CCTL log's result line is not the one ruled on (9.168); nothing removed"; exit 1; }
w=$(cut -d' ' -f1 <<< "$(sha256sum < "$D/delta/words_cells.tsv")"); echo "delta/words_cells.tsv sha256 $w (expect $XWC)"
[ "$w" = "$XWC" ] || { echo "RMTC RESULT: STOP - not the CCTL run folder's delta - wrong folder?; nothing removed"; exit 1; }
n=$(stat -c %s "$T"); echo "T_c.db: $n bytes (expect $XT_SIZE)"
[ "$n" = "$XT_SIZE" ] || { echo "RMTC RESULT: STOP - T_c.db is not the size the delta read; nothing removed"; exit 1; }
echo "=== the run folder before ==="
ls -l --time-style=full-iso "$D"
k0=$(find "$D" -type f -not -path "$T" -printf '%s %T@ %p\n' | sort)
c0=$(stat -c '%s %Y %n' "$S" "$B" "$P")
me=$(id -un)
dk0=$(cut -f1 <<< "$(du -sk ~ 2>/dev/null)"); tm0=$(find /tmp -user "$me" -type f -printf '%s\n' 2>/dev/null | awk '{s += $1} END {print s + 0}')
echo "home in use before: $dk0 KB; my files in /tmp: $tm0 bytes (the quota counts both, DESIGN 9.167)"
# --- the removal ---
echo "=== removing T_c.db ==="
rm -- "$T"; rr=$?
echo "rm exit code: $rr (expect 0)"
# --- after the removal: every miss is CHECK (nothing to restore - T_c is a throwaway) ---
bad=0
[ "$rr" = 0 ] || { echo "CHECK: the rm failed"; bad=1; }
[ -e "$T" ] && { echo "CHECK: still present: $T"; bad=1; }
k1=$(find "$D" -type f -printf '%s %T@ %p\n' | sort)
echo "every other file in the run folder: size and time before = after: $([ "$k1" = "$k0" ] && echo yes || echo NO) ($(wc -l <<< "$k1") files)"
[ "$k1" = "$k0" ] || { echo "CHECK: the run folder's other files changed:"; diff <(echo "$k0") <(echo "$k1"); bad=1; }
c1=$(stat -c '%s %Y %n' "$S" "$B" "$P")
echo "src, built, pre_8b: size and time before = after: $([ "$c1" = "$c0" ] && echo yes || echo NO)"
[ "$c1" = "$c0" ] || { echo "CHECK: a kept copy changed:"; echo "$c0"; echo "$c1"; bad=1; }
echo "=== the run folder after ==="
ls -l --time-style=full-iso "$D"
dk1=$(cut -f1 <<< "$(du -sk ~ 2>/dev/null)"); tm1=$(find /tmp -user "$me" -type f -printf '%s\n' 2>/dev/null | awk '{s += $1} END {print s + 0}')
echo "home in use after: $dk1 KB (before $dk0 KB; freed $((dk0 - dk1)) KB); my files in /tmp after: $tm1 bytes"
echo "home + /tmp after: $(( dk1 + tm1 / 1024 )) KB (what the quota counts; the PA dashboard is the quota's own figure)"
[ "$bad" = 0 ] || { echo "RMTC RESULT: CHECK - lines above; nothing to restore (throwaway copy) - to the ruling chat as printed"; exit 1; }
echo "RMTC RESULT: DONE - $(date -u +%FT%TZ) - T_c.db removed; the run folder's other files kept"; exit 0
) 2>&1 | tee "$L"; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; fi
```

```bash
def lit(s):
    return ast.literal_eval(s)


def same(exp, got):
    if exp == BL:
        return got is None or got == ""
    return (got == exp) or (isinstance(exp, int) and isinstance(got, str) and got == str(exp))


def rows(path):
    f = open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="surrogateescape", newline="\n")
    head = f.readline().rstrip("\n").split("\t")
    out = []
    for line in f:
        out.append(line.rstrip("\n").split("\t"))
    f.close()
    return head, out


def cells(folder):
    h, rs = rows(folder / "words_cells.tsv")
    assert h == ["book", "chapter", "verse", "position", "column", "a", "b", "moved"], h
    d = {}
    for r in rs:
        d[(r[0], int(r[1]), int(r[2]), int(r[3]), r[4])] = (r[5], r[6], r[7])
    return d


def nlines(path):
    return len(rows(path)[1])
```

```bash
n=$(stat -c %s "$T"); echo "the copy: $n bytes (expect $XT_SIZE)"
[ "$n" = "$XT_SIZE" ] || { echo "RMLC RESULT: STOP - the copy is not the size LIVESRC printed; nothing removed"; exit 1; }
echo "=== the run folder before ==="

k0=$(find "$D" -type f -not -path "$T" -printf '%s %T@ %p\n' | sort)

echo "home in use before: $dk0 KB; my files in /tmp: $tm0 bytes (the quota counts both, DESIGN 9.167)"
# --- the removal ---

rm -- "$T"; rr=$?
echo "rm exit code: $rr (expect 0)"
# --- after the removal: every miss is CHECK (nothing to restore - the copy is a throwaway; live is not touched) ---
bad=0
[ "$rr" = 0 ] || { echo "CHECK: the rm failed"; bad=1; }
[ -e "$T" ] && { echo "CHECK: still present: $T"; bad=1; }
k1=$(find "$D" -type f -printf '%s %T@ %p\n' | sort)
echo "every other file in the run folder: size and time before = after: $([ "$k1" = "$k0" ] && echo yes || echo NO) ($(wc -l <<< "$k1") files)"
[ "$k1" = "$k0" ] || { echo "CHECK: the run folder's other files changed:"; diff <(echo "$k0") <(echo "$k1"); bad=1; }
c1=$(stat -c '%s %Y %n' "$S" "$B" "$P")
echo "src, built, pre_8b: size and time before = after: $([ "$c1" = "$c0" ] && echo yes || echo NO)"
[ "$c1" = "$c0" ] || { echo "CHECK: a kept copy changed:"; echo "$c0"; echo "$c1"; bad=1; }
echo "=== the run folder after ==="
ls -l --time-style=full-iso "$D"
dk1=$(cut -f1 <<< "$(du -sk ~ 2>/dev/null)"); tm1=$(find /tmp -user "$me" -type f -printf '%s\n' 2>/dev/null | awk '{s += $1} END {print s + 0}')
echo "home in use after: $dk1 KB (before $dk0 KB; freed $((dk0 - dk1)) KB); my files in /tmp after: $tm1 bytes"
echo "home + /tmp after: $(( dk1 + tm1 / 1024 )) KB (what the quota counts; the PA dashboard is the quota's own figure)"
[ "$bad" = 0 ] || { echo "RMLC RESULT: CHECK - lines above; nothing to restore (throwaway copy) - to the ruling chat as printed"; exit 1; }
echo "RMLC RESULT: DONE - $(date -u +%FT%TZ) - the copy removed; the run folder's other files kept"; exit 0
) 2>&1 | tee "$L"; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; fi
```

```bash

L=~/edition_upgrade_runs/gate_sources_20261118.log

  echo "--- tsv header ---"; head -1 "$T"

  awk '/REORDER|SPLIT|DIFFERS|SKIPPED/ && n < 40 { print NR ":" $0; n++ }' "$T"
  echo "--- tsv: count of each value in every column (of the first 5) holding REORDER / DIFFERS / SKIPPED / same; at most 20 values each ---"
  awk -F'\t' '{ for (i = 1; i <= 5 && i <= NF; i++) { c[i, $i]++; if ($i ~ /REORDER|DIFFERS|SKIPPED|^same$/) hit[i] = 1 } }
    END { for (i = 1; i <= 5; i++) if (hit[i]) { print "column " i ":"; m = 0; for (k in c) { split(k, p, SUBSEP); if (p[1] == i && m < 20) { print "  " c[k] "  " p[2]; m++ } } } }' "$T"

  if [ "$n" -le 150 ]; then cat -n "$G"; else awk 'NR <= 60 { printf "%6d\t%s\n", NR, $0 }' "$G"; echo "..."; awk '/REORDER|SPLIT|DIFFERS|SKIPPED|RESULT|rows/ && n < 60 { print NR ":" $0; n++ }' "$G"; fi
```

```bash
def find(gate, *what):

    if finds[gate] <= 40:

def same(x, y):          # sqlite values, type-strict (1 and '1' differ)

def rows(path):

        head = f.readline().rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        return head, [ln.rstrip("\n").split("\t") for ln in f]


def ro(path):
    c = sqlite3.connect("%s?mode=ro" % Path(path).resolve().as_uri(), uri=True)
    c.text_factory = lambda b: b.decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape")
    c.execute("PRAGMA query_only=1")
    return c


def verdict(gate):

        elif k not in decl:
            find("G2", "in the delta, NOT declared", k, got[k])
        elif not (same(decl[k][0], got[k][0]) and same(decl[k][1], got[k][1])):
            find("G2", "value differs", k, "declared", decl[k], "delta", got[k])
    verdict("G2")

    # ---------- G3: moved pairs = the census swaps; position has no other member ----------
    print("=== G3 moved pairs = the 10 census swaps both ways; unpaired 0 / 0 ===")
    want = set()
    for vk, (p, pq) in swaps.items():
        want.add(vk + (p, pq))
        want.add(vk + (pq, p))
    have = set((r[0], int(r[1]), int(r[2]), int(r[3]), int(r[4])) for r in mv)
    print("  moved rows %d (declared %d)" % (len(have), len(want)))
    for k in sorted(want ^ have, key=str):
        find("G3", "moved pair %s" % ("declared, not in the delta" if k in want else "in the delta, not declared"), k)
    for n in ("words_unpaired.tsv", "words_only.tsv"):
        m = len(rows(F / n)[1])
        print("  %-20s %d lines (expect 0)" % (n, m))
        if m:
            find("G3", n, "not empty", m)
    verdict("G3")

    # ---------- G4: the four columns = the composition, carried by G1 (DESIGN 9.185 (4), option a) ----------
    print("=== G4 english / english_head / greek_pos / bracket_id = the composition (9.178 (4)); carried by G1 ===")
    by = Counter(k[4] for k in W)
    print("  members: " + " - ".join("%s %d" % (c, by[c]) for c in ("english", "english_head", "greek_pos", "bracket_id")))
    if finds["G1"]:
        find("G4", "G1 did not hold - the composition ruling does not carry to this delta")
    verdict("G4")

    # ---------- G5: english_head_norm by step 11's rule on EVERY row of src and built (DESIGN 9.142 (3)) ----------
    print("=== G5 english_head_norm = _norm_or_none(english_head) on every row, src and built ===")
    for name, c in (("src", S), ("built", B)):
        n = heads = broke = 0
        for bk, chp, vs, pos, head, norm in c.execute(
                "SELECT v.book, v.chapter, v.verse, w.position, w.english_head, w.english_head_norm "
                "FROM words w JOIN verses v ON v.id = w.verse_id"):
            n += 1
            e = _norm_or_none(head)
            if e is not None:
                heads += 1
            if not same(norm, e):
                broke += 1
                find("G5", name, (bk, chp, vs, pos), "head", head, "stored", norm, "rule", e)
        print("  %-5s rows %d - rows the rule gives a value %d - broken %d (expect 0)" % (name, n, heads, broke))
    nm = [k for k in W if k[4] == "english_head_norm"]
    off = [k for k in nm if k[:4] + ("english_head",) not in W]
    print("  english_head_norm members %d; at a position where english_head does not differ: %d (expect 0)" % (len(nm), len(off)))
    for k in off:
        find("G5", "norm member without an english_head member", k, W[k][:2])
    verdict("G5")

    # ---------- G6: verses.text (DESIGN 9.143 (2), 9.144 (1) as replaced by 9.185 (3)) ----------
    print("=== G6 verses.text = B written - the EU rows equal to src; the 49 / 69 by value; the rest by the 9.185 (3) length rule ===")
    print("  prose list sha256: %s - EU rows file sha256: %s" % (sha(PROSE), sha(EUF)))
    ph, pr = rows(PROSE)
    if not ph == ["book", "chapter", "verse", "outcome", "reason", "old_len", "new_len", "changed"]:
        raise Stop("prose list header: %r" % ph)
    P = {(r[0], int(r[1]), int(r[2])): r for r in pr}
    written = {k for k, r in P.items() if r[3] == "written"}
    eh, er = rows(EUF)
    ix = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(eh)}
    eu = {}
    for r in er:
        if r[ix["field"]] == "verses.text":
            k = (r[ix["book"]], int(r[ix["chapter"]]), int(r[ix["verse"]]))
            if k in eu:
                find("G6", "two EU verses.text rows on one verse", k)
            eu[k] = r[ix["corrected_value"]]

    def texts(c):
        return {(b, ch_, v): t for b, ch_, v, t in c.execute("SELECT book, chapter, verse, text FROM verses")}
    ST, BT = texts(S), texts(B)
    print("  B written %d (stageB_Bapply :2: 15,571) - EU verses.text rows %d (118)" % (len(written), len(eu)))
    if not len(written) == XWRIT:
        find("G6", "B written is not 15,571", len(written))
    for k in eu:
        if k not in written:
            find("G6", "EU verses.text row on a verse B did not write", k)
    g49 = sorted(k for k in eu if same(eu[k], ST.get(k)))
    g69 = sorted(k for k in eu if k not in set(g49))
    print("  EU rows whose corrected_value = src's text: %d (expect %d) - the others: %d (expect %d)" % (len(g49), X49, len(g69), X69))
    if not (len(g49) == X49 and len(g69) == X69):
        find("G6", "49 / 69 split differs", len(g49), len(g69))
    for k in g49:
        if not same(BT.get(k), eu[k]):
            find("G6", "one of the 49: built is not corrected (= src)", k, BT.get(k), eu[k])
    for k in g69:
        if not same(BT.get(k), eu[k]):
            find("G6", "one of the 69: built is not corrected", k, BT.get(k), eu[k])
    declared = written - set(g49)
    print("  declared %d (expect %d) - delta verses %d - declared, not in the delta %d - in the delta, not declared %d"
          % (len(declared), XDECL, len(V), len(declared - set(V)), len(set(V) - declared)))
    if not len(declared) == XDECL:
        find("G6", "declared count is not 15,522", len(declared))
    for k in sorted(declared - set(V)):
        find("G6", "declared, NOT in the delta", k)
    for k in sorted(set(V) - declared):
        find("G6", "in the delta, NOT declared", k)
    rest = sorted(k for k in declared if k not in eu)
    fail = 0
    for k in rest:
        t = BT.get(k)
        nl = int(P[k][6])
        if t is None or not (len(t) + t.count(EM) == nl):
            fail += 1
            find("G6", "length rule (9.185 (3))", k, "new_len", nl, "built len", None if t is None else len(t),
                 "dashes", None if t is None else t.count(EM), "built text", t)
    print("  non-EU members %d (computed) - len(built) + count(em-dash) = new_len fails: %d (expect 0)" % (len(rest), fail))
    verdict("G6")

    # ---------- G7: named rows ----------
    print("=== G7 named rows ===")
    (ik, ia, ib) = ISA
    hk, nk = ik + ("english_head",), ik + ("english_head_norm",)
    print("  Isa 48:5 @4 english_head: %r (declared %r -> %r, DESIGN 9.148 (2))" % (W.get(hk, ("absent",))[:2], ia, ib))
    if not (hk in W and same(W[hk][0], ia) and same(W[hk][1], ib)):
        find("G7", "Isa 48:5 @4 english_head is not 'would' -> 'what' in the delta", W.get(hk))
    print("  Isa 48:5 @4 english_head_norm: %r (present; values by the G5 rule)" % (W.get(nk, ("absent",))[:2],))
    if nk not in W:
        find("G7", "Isa 48:5 @4 english_head_norm cell absent")
    mvk = set((r[0], int(r[1]), int(r[2])) for r in mv)
    for vk in NONE_IN:
        m = [k for k in W if k[:3] == vk] + ([vk] if vk in V else []) + ([vk] if vk in mvk else [])
        print("  %s %d:%d members: %d (expect 0)" % (vk[0], vk[1], vk[2], len(m)))
        for k in m:
            find("G7", "member in a verse declared to have none", k)
    for k in JOH_ABSENT:
        print("  Joh 19:18 @10 %s: %s (expect absent, DESIGN 9.156 (2) / 9.157 (3))" % (k[4], "absent" if k not in W else "PRESENT %r" % (W[k][:2],)))
        if k in W:
            find("G7", "Joh 19:18 @10 cell declared absent is in the delta", k, W[k][:2])
    jo = [k for k in W if k[:3] == JOH_SHOW and k not in JOH_ABSENT]
    print("  Joh 19:18 other members (read-out, not declared, DESIGN 9.186): words %d - verses.text %s - moved %s"
          % (len(jo), "yes" if JOH_SHOW in V else "no", "yes" if JOH_SHOW in mvk else "no"))
    for k in sorted(jo, key=str):
        print("    @%d %-18s %r -> %r" % (k[3], k[4], W[k][0], W[k][1]))
    if JOH_SHOW in V:
        print("    verses.text %r -> %r" % V[JOH_SHOW])
    for vk in SHOW:
        print("  %s %d:%d (read-out, not declared):" % vk)
        for k in sorted((k for k in W if k[:3] == vk), key=str):
            print("    @%d %-18s %r -> %r" % (k[3], k[4], W[k][0], W[k][1]))
        if vk in V:
            print("    verses.text %r -> %r" % V[vk])
    verdict("G7")

    # ---------- G8: zeros and the delta's own summary ----------
    print("=== G8 italic columns 0; one-side files empty; rows; 13 columns + text, none one-sided ===")
    for col in ("italic", "italic_words", "smcap_words"):
        m = sum(1 for k in W if k[4] == col)
        print("  %-14s %d (expect 0)" % (col, m))
        if m:
            find("G8", col, "has members", m)
    vo = len(rows(F / "verses_only.tsv")[1])
    print("  verses_only.tsv %d lines (expect 0)" % vo)
    if vo:
        find("G8", "verses_only not empty", vo)
    summ = (F / "summary.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").split("\n")
    for s in SUMMARY:
        ok = s in summ
        print("  summary line present: %s - %s" % ("yes" if ok else "NO", s))
        if not ok:
            find("G8", "summary line missing", s)
    verdict("G8")
    S.close()
    B.close()
except Stop as e:
    print("GATE CHECK: STOP - %s" % e)
    sys.exit(2)

try:
    import resource
    print("check peak memory (max resident): %d MB" % (resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss // 1024))
except ImportError:
    pass
tot = sum(finds.values())
print("FINDINGS: %d (%s)" % (tot, ", ".join("%s %d" % (g, finds[g]) for g in sorted(finds)) or "none"))
if tot > sum(min(n, 40) for n in finds.values()):
    print("  (more findings than printed: each gate prints its first 40)")
print("STEP-4 GATE CHECK: %s" % ("PASS - G1 to G8 hold" if tot == 0 else "FINDING - lines above"))
sys.exit(0 if tot == 0 else 3)
PYEOF
k=$(h "$D/check.py"); echo "check.py sha256: $k (expect $XCHK)"
[ "$k" = "$XCHK" ] || { echo "STEP4GATE RESULT: STOP - check.py is not the file CC wrote and tested (paste changed?)"; exit 1; }
# --- the fresh delta src -> built ---
echo "=== (1) eu_words_delta --a src --b built - start $(date -u +%FT%TZ) ==="
mkdir "$D/delta" || { echo "STEP4GATE RESULT: STOP - cannot make $D/delta"; exit 1; }
EU scripts/eu_words_delta.py --a "$S" --b "$B" --out "$D/delta" < /dev/null > "$D/delta.out" 2>&1; r1=$?
cat "$D/delta.out"; echo "delta exit $r1 (expect 0) - end $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
[ "$r1" = 0 ] && [ -n "$(sed -n '/^RESULT: DELTA WRITTEN/p' "$D/delta.out")" ] || { echo "STEP4GATE RESULT: STOP - the delta did not finish (partial files kept in $D/delta)"; exit 1; }
# --- the gate ---
echo "=== (2) the gate check G1-G8 - start $(date -u +%FT%TZ) ==="
EU "$D/check.py" "$D" "$C" "$S" "$B" "$CEN" "$PRO" "$EUF" < /dev/null > "$D/check.out" 2>&1; r2=$?
cat "$D/check.out"; echo "check exit $r2 (expect 0; 3 = findings; 2 = an input not as declared) - end $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"
# --- after: copies unchanged (read-only run) ---
s1=$(h "$S"); echo "src sha256 after: $s1 (= before: $([ "$s1" = "$s0" ] && echo yes || echo NO))"
st1=$(stat -c '%s %Y %n' "$S" "$B")
echo "src, built: size and time before = after: $([ "$st1" = "$st0" ] && echo yes || echo NO)"
EU scripts/eu_step.py check --tag STEP4GATE --built "$B" --dir "$DH" --written words,abp_corrections > "$D/check_after.out" 2>&1; r3=$?
tail -n 1 "$D/check_after.out"; echo "built = HEADFIX2's result after: exit $r3 (expect 0)"
[ "$s1" = "$s0" ] && [ "$st1" = "$st0" ] && [ "$r3" = 0 ] || { echo "STEP4GATE RESULT: STOP - a copy changed during a read-only run - report this as printed"; exit 1; }
case "$r2" in
  0) echo "STEP4GATE RESULT: PASS - $(date -u +%FT%TZ) - src -> built = the declared lists in every column, G1-G8 hold; to the ruling chat"; exit 0 ;;
  3) echo "STEP4GATE RESULT: FINDING - $(date -u +%FT%TZ) - the members above (and $D/check.out) go to the ruling chat as printed; read-only, nothing to restore"; exit 1 ;;
  *) echo "STEP4GATE RESULT: STOP - the check stopped or did not finish (exit $r2; $D/check.out)"; exit 1 ;;
esac
) 2>&1 | tee "$L"; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; fi
```
